steps.player: Who are you?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Why, I'm Dondakan, of course!

options.text: Why are you firing a cannon at a wall?

steps.player: Why are you firing a cannon at a wall?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: It's not a wall! It's a rock!

steps.player: What's the difference?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: It's a very special rock!

steps.player: I still don't quite follow...

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Oh, for Guthix' sake, it's perfectly simple! See, that rock over there, it's impenetrable!

steps.player: Have you tried taking a pickaxe to it?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Of course I have, I'm holding this rune pickaxe, aren't I? We've been trying to mine through it for years!

steps.player: We? I don't see anyone else.

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Well, I'm the only one left... all the others gave up. Said it wasn't worth their while anymore. Wouldn't have a good return profit on their time investment.

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: At first we thought there might be a huge treasure behind the rock, you see.

steps.player: Isn't there?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Until we had a look further down the stream, around the rock... no, there's no treasure there, just a dead end.

steps.player: Okay... so why were you trying to get through the rock again?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Because obviously there are vast deposits of minerals inside the rock! And if not, I want to harness the extreme hardness of the rock itself!

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: The only problem is that I have run out of ideas on how to do it.

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Perhaps a young adventurer like you is willing to help out an old dwarf like me? Want to find out what's inside the rock?

steps.prompt: Start the Between a Rock... quest?

steps.player: Sure, sounds interesting!

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Welcome aboard then!

steps.player: No thanks, I do enough mining on my own.

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Suit yourself, I don't need any help from a human anyway!

steps.player: Bit noisy here, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Cozy? No, not really, it's damp and cold!

steps.player: No! I said it's noisy!

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Then stop shouting!

steps.player: Goodbye!
Any idea on what's inside the rock?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: No, but that's where you come in!

steps.player: How so?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: I want you to find out some more information on the rock.

steps.player: Now where would I do that?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: I don't know! Wish I knew!

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: But we have to get some better understanding of what this thing actually is. Maybe then we can find a way to break it open.

steps.player: And what are you going to do while I go running across half of Gielinor, I'll wager?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: I'll guard my cannon and fire more cannonballs at it, of course! Wish I had your job, mine's a tough one!

steps.player: Want to trade places?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: My legs are too old and worn to do much running around anymore, I'm afraid.

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Well, off you go now! Start running, start talking!

steps.player: But I still don't know where!

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Oh, why so difficult?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Look, try the city, further down the stream here. There's bound to be someone there who knows something. If you still can't find anyone, go to the librarian, he knows a lot.

options.text: What did you need me to do?

steps.player: What did you need me to do?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: I want you to find out some more information on the rock.

steps.player: Now where would I do that?
I'll be back later.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.text: See Miodvetnir, Derni, and Dernu#Subsequent dialogue

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-knowledge-o.speaker: Librarian
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-knowledge-o.text: Welcome to the Keldagrim library, human traveller!

options.text: Can you tell me more about the library?
What do you know about impenetrable rocks?

steps.player: What do you know about impenetrable rocks?

steps.speaker: Librarian
steps.text: You're confusing me, what rock exactly are you talking about?

steps.player: The big one in the mines south of the city. Dondakan's big rock.

steps.speaker: Librarian
steps.text: I see, I see.

steps.speaker: Librarian
steps.text: But I don't know much about that rock, I'm afraid. It's baffled us for many generations.

steps.speaker: Librarian
steps.text: There is a dwarf in the mechanics shop, though, who I believe has some connections with a certain scholar.

steps.player: Where can I find him exactly?

steps.speaker: Librarian
steps.text: Go south to the palace, the shop is called Wemund's Wrench Warehouse. He should be working there somewhere.

steps.player: Thanks!

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-engineer-i-.player: Do you know anything about this rock in the mines?

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-engineer-i-.speaker: Dwarven Engineer
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-engineer-i-.text: Now what rock would that be, exactly?

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-engineer-i-.player: The big rock in the mines to the south, with an old dwarf standing beside it..?
Er, yes, I think so. Do you know what it's made of?

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-engineer-i-.speaker: Dwarven Engineer
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-engineer-i-.text: No, no one knows. No one here, anyway. The only one I can think of is Rolad, a renowned scholar. He was part of Dondakan's team once, many years ago.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-engineer-i-.player: So where can I find this Rolad?

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-engineer-i-.speaker: Dwarven Engineer
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-engineer-i-.text: He left to explore the world. Learning by experience, or so he said. Me, I prefer a cold stout at home, but it takes all sorts.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-engineer-i-.speaker: Dwarven Engineer
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-engineer-i-.text: I think he's currently with the Black Guard at Ice Mountain.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.player: Excuse me... would you happen to be Rolad the scholar?

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.speaker: Rolad
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.text: Why, yes, I think so... who's asking?

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.player: [player name], and I've come to ask you about a rock.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.speaker: Rolad
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.text: You're awfully tall for a dwarf, you know, [player name]. And a rock you say? I suppose I know a fair bit about rocks, yes.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.player: It's this rock that Dondakan is trying to break open. You know Dondakan, right?

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.speaker: Rolad
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.text: Oh, old Dondakan, sure I know him. And I know his rock too. It's that unbreakable one, isn't it?

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.player: Yes, that's the one. What can you tell me about it?

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.speaker: Rolad
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.text: Well, as a matter of fact, I picked up an interesting book on one of my travels, from a quite out of the way dwarven outpost.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.speaker: Rolad
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.text: I'm not entirely sure, but it seems to describe this very rock, and how it came to be placed in that cavern. I tore out the most interesting pages for more detailed perusal. Let me get them for you.
There is a slight pause, as Rolad realizes something is wrong.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.speaker: Rolad
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.text: I seem to have misplaced the pages... a pity, I had wanted to study them some more. Oh well...

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.player: What? No! I need that book!

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.speaker: Rolad
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.text: Oh, well, if it's that important to you, perhaps you can go and look for the pages? There should be three of them.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.speaker: Rolad
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.text: I probably lost them in the mines below. I don't have them up here in any case.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.speaker: Rolad
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.text: No no, I never go there, I'm not a member you know. But I sometimes go down to the regular mines to study the conditions of the working dwarf.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-rolad-the-s.player: Okay, thanks, I'll go and look for the pages then.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.player: Rolad has a book that might help us!

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.text: A book? How's a book going to help? What's in it?

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.player: Well, that's the problem... the most important pages are missing.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.text: Then run along and find them!

steps.text: You turn over the corpse of the scorpion and find a missing page of Rolad's book! Unfortunately, you can't carry it and are forced to drop it on the ground.
At the bottom of the cart you find a missing page of Rolad's book! Unfortunately, you can't carry it and are forced to drop it on the ground.
You see something lying just behind the rock you just mined... it's a missing page of Rolad's book!
Unfortunately, you can't carry it and are forced to drop it on the ground.
You turn over the corpse of the scorpion and find a missing page of Rolad's book!
At the bottom of the cart you find a missing page of Rolad's book!
You see something lying just behind the rock you just mined... it's a missing page of Rolad's book!

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-hi-ho-hi-ho.text: You've found all three of Rolad's missing pages. Return them to him so he can put them back in his book.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.speaker: Rolad
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.text: How are you getting on with finding those missing pages?
If the player is yet to find any pages:

steps.player: I haven't found a single one yet, I have no idea where I should be looking.

steps.speaker: Rolad
steps.text: Down in the mines below, that'd be my best bet. I don't know where though, they could be anywhere down there.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.text: If the player has found only one page:

steps.player: Well, I found the first page, but I still have two to go.

steps.speaker: Rolad
steps.text: That's splendid, keep going and you'll find them all, I'm sure!

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.text: If the player has found only two pages:

steps.player: I found two of the pages! But I haven't found the last one yet.

steps.speaker: Rolad
steps.text: Marvelous! I'm sure it's only a matter of time before you find the final page!

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.text: If the player has found all of the pages:

steps.player: Look, I found all of your missing pages!

steps.speaker: Rolad
steps.text: Missing pages..?

steps.player: Yes, the missing pages of that book we were talking about earlier?

steps.speaker: Rolad
steps.text: Oh yes, quite right... let me see them, please, and I'll put the book back together for you.
Player hands over the pages to Rolad.

steps.speaker: Rolad
steps.text: There you go... You will give it back when you've finished with it, won't you? I'd really like to study it in more detail some time.

steps.player: Of course, I'd be happy to!

steps.speaker: Rolad
steps.text: Splendid, now, there's a good dwarf!

steps.player: Of course... when I've finished with it I'll give it back to you, sure...

steps.speaker: Rolad
steps.text: Splendid, now, there's a good dwarf!

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.player: Thanks again for that book, I really appreciate it.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.speaker: Rolad
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.text: Oh yes, have you read it yet?

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.player: No, not yet, but I will.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-after-readi.text: That certainly was an interesting read! You now have enough info for Dondakan. You should go back to him.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-if-the-play.player: Ahem... errr... I lost that book you gave me.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-if-the-play.speaker: Rolad
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-if-the-play.text: That's terrible! Have you even read it yet?

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-if-the-play.player: No, I hadn't had the chance yet.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-if-the-play.speaker: Rolad
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-if-the-play.text: Well, here, I happened to have a copy of it. Try not to lose it this time!

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-if-the-play.player: Wait, if you had a copy of it, why did I have to look for your missing pages?

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-if-the-play.speaker: Rolad
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-if-the-play.text: I suppose I just forgot that I had one.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.player: That was quite an interesting book you gave me.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.speaker: Rolad
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.text: Oh yes, have you read it yet?

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.player: Yes, but I'd like to hang on to it a little longer, if I may.

an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.speaker: Rolad
an-unbreakable-rock-or-stone-talking-to-.text: Why, naturally, that's no problem for someone with such a keen interest in expanding [his/her/their] knowledge!

going-for-the-gold-returning-to-dondakan.player: Rolad gave me a book that was quite interesting to read! I think I know what's inside it!
Ehm, well... a demonic spirit for one...
A demonic spirit! And apparently the inside of the rock is lined with gold!

going-for-the-gold-returning-to-dondakan.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
going-for-the-gold-returning-to-dondakan.text: Gold! I knew it! I struck gold! I'm set for life!

going-for-the-gold-returning-to-dondakan.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
going-for-the-gold-returning-to-dondakan.text: Now tell me, how do I break open the rock?

going-for-the-gold-returning-to-dondakan.player: Sorry, the book doesn't say... it doesn't seem to be particularly concerned with actually breaking open the rock. You see, the demonic spirit is being kept inside it.

going-for-the-gold-returning-to-dondakan.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
going-for-the-gold-returning-to-dondakan.text: Yes yes, I heard you the first time.

going-for-the-gold-returning-to-dondakan.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
going-for-the-gold-returning-to-dondakan.text: Well, we're not very much closer to a solution then, are we?

options.text: What have you tried so far?

steps.player: What have you tried so far?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Well, let's see...

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: At one time, we had a hundred dwarves in here, all picking away at the rock. Didn't do a thing.

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Then there was the time when we set fire to this whole section of the cave. What a smell that made!

steps.player: Any effect?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Apart from coating the rock with soot? Not really, no.

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: I was able to borrow a cannon from the Black Guard, my son was able to pull some strings you know.

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Of course, steel cannonballs didn't make a dent. But then ol' Donnie had a clever idea.

steps.player: Oh really?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: I made this adamantite cannonball, you see! Cost me quite a pile of coins too!

steps.player: Wow! That must have made quite an impact!

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Well, yes, it did... when it bounced back onto the ground it did.

steps.player: What else did you try?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Well, then I had an even more clever idea!

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: I put an even bigger pile of coins together to get some rune cannonballs! Good idea, right?

steps.player: Yeah, great!

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: No, it wasn't. Didn't do anything! Nothing at all!

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Latest thing I've tried are these boots.

steps.player: Nice boots... but what about them?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: They're made out of granite! I don't have enough money left to make granite cannonballs though. But see!
Dondakan walks up the passage, kicks it, and walks back.

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Did you see? Did you?

steps.player: I er... didn't see anything.

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: That's because there wasn't anything to see! Even granite doesn't do anything to it!

steps.player: And now I have to come up with a material that will affect it somehow?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: You got it!

steps.player: Some kind of new material that no one has ever found before but which I am supposed to accidentally stumble upon, perhaps?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Don't be silly, I'm sure there must be some known material that will affect it.

steps.player: I'm tired of these stories.

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Go on then... leave an old dwarf to his work.

options.text: Maybe we need to set up another cannon?

steps.player: Maybe we should set up another cannon?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Another cannon? How will that help?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: No, no, what we need is a different material of cannonballs. The hardest, toughest you can find.

steps.player: How do you mean, that I can find? What are you doing then?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: I'm guarding the cannon. Won't do us much good if it were stolen, would it?

steps.player: I'll be back later.

going-for-the-gold-using-random-items-on.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
going-for-the-gold-using-random-items-on.text: What am I supposed to do with that?

going-for-the-gold-using-perfect-gold-on.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
going-for-the-gold-using-perfect-gold-on.text: Perfect gold? That's much too valuable to be used to make cannonballs!

going-for-the-gold-using-gold-ore-bar-on.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
going-for-the-gold-using-gold-ore-bar-on.text: Haha, you want me to make a golden cannonball?

going-for-the-gold-using-gold-ore-bar-on.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
going-for-the-gold-using-gold-ore-bar-on.text: You know that apart from being heavy it's also very soft, don't you? It'd be a pointless waste!

going-for-the-gold-using-gold-ore-bar-on.player: Well... the book does say that there's gold inside the rock, so I thought perhaps gold can damage it as well.

going-for-the-gold-using-gold-ore-bar-on.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
going-for-the-gold-using-gold-ore-bar-on.text: Hmm, I suppose you have a point there.

going-for-the-gold-using-gold-ore-bar-on.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
going-for-the-gold-using-gold-ore-bar-on.text: Tell you what, if you make a golden cannonball and give it to me, I'll fire it at the rock.

going-for-the-gold-using-a-gold-ore-bar-.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
going-for-the-gold-using-a-gold-ore-bar-.text: Yes, you already showed me that. But I'm not going to waste my own gold on it, make a cannonball and bring it to me.

going-for-the-gold-using-gold-bar-on-a-f.prompt: Do you wish to make a golden cannonball?

steps.text: You heat the gold bar
...You heat the gold bar to a liquid state...
...You pour it into your cannonball mould...
...You then leave it to cool for a short while.
You make one beautiful golden cannonball.
Shows regular crafting options

going-for-the-gold-using-the-golden-cann.player: I have that golden cannonball you asked me to make.

going-for-the-gold-using-the-golden-cann.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
going-for-the-gold-using-the-golden-cann.text: That... that... that's an amazing looking cannonball!

going-for-the-gold-using-the-golden-cann.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
going-for-the-gold-using-the-golden-cann.text: Are you sure you want me to fire it at the rock? It's going to make a nasty dent in it. In the cannonball that is.

options.text: Yes, I'm sure this will crack open the rock.

steps.player: Yes, I'm sure this will crack open the rock.

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: It breaks my heart to ruin such a fine piece of crafting, but it's your gold... Alright, let's load it up then.
The cannon fires the golden cannonball through the passage

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Did... did... did you see that?

steps.player: The cannonball went right through it!

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: I don't believe it! All this time, I've been spending all my gold on opening the rock... I could've just thrown it at it!

steps.player: But... the rock didn't actually break, did it?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: No, it seemed more like it... gave way for a second... That's interesting...

steps.player: So how does this help us?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Why, I'll just shoot you through it so you can have a look, won't I?

steps.player: Shoot me... through it? Errr... what exactly do you mean?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Very simple. I'll have to make a few modifications to my cannon so that it can fire a human, and you'll need a golden helmet of course.

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Then I'll fire you at the rock so you can do a little reconnaissance. Don't worry, you should land safely on the other side of the rock.

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Might want to pick up that cannonball again while you're at it!

steps.player: But... what if I bump into that demon, the one from the book?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Don't be silly now. It's just a rock... just a rock with lots of gold in it!

options.text: So you want to... fire me into the rock?

steps.player: So you want to... fire me into the rock?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Yes, just to see what's inside... to see if all that gold is really embedded inside it.

steps.player: Are you sure that it's safe?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: No, but then we'll never know until we've tried it, right?

options.text: Find someone else for your bizarre experiment!

steps.player: Find someone else for your bizarre experiment, I'm not going to crawl into that cannon of yours! Or have you shoot me at a solid rock!

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: But we're so close to all that gold!

steps.player: Forget it.

options.text: I can't argue with that, shoot me in!

steps.player: I can't argue with that, shoot me in!

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Well, it's not so simple... like I said, I need to make some modifications to my cannon. They're not really designed to fire humans, you know.

steps.player: Okay, I'll just wait right here until you've made them.

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: I don't really know how, actually. Never been much of an engineer.

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: If I had the right schematics for it, I could probably work with that. But I don't.

steps.player: Okay, so you want me to look for the schematics for you, is that it?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: That's it, yes! Here, I have one part of the schematics, sent to me by some prankster dwarf, I don't even remember his name. You'll have to find the rest on your own.

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Oh, and you'll also need a golden helmet of course. Would hurt quite a bit otherwise.

steps.player: Won't a gold plated helmet do?

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: No, it has to be a helmet made out of solid gold. Gold plated helmets contain so little actual gold, it'd be a bit dangerous.

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Unless you want to die when I shoot you at the rock?

steps.player: No no, I'll get you a helmet made out of solid gold.
Although that will be a horrendously heavy thing to actually wear.

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Yes yes, well, get going now, why don't you? I'll guard the cannon while you're away.

steps.player: That's what I thought you'd say.

steps.text: If the player has room in their inventory:
Schematic (Dondakan)
If the player's inventory is full:
You have no space in your inventory and drop the schematic on the ground.

options.text: My head's spinning, I have to go for a bit.

steps.player: My head's spinning, I have to go for a bit.

options.text: No, I'd rather sell it for a huge profit.

finding-the-schematics-talking-to-dondak.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
finding-the-schematics-talking-to-dondak.text: And it could be that someone in the mines or the city here knows where this part came from. Didn't you talk to someone in Keldagrim already? Just ask around!

finding-the-schematics-talking-to-khorva.player: I'm looking for schematics to modify the dwarven multicannon to fire a human. Can you help?

finding-the-schematics-talking-to-khorva.speaker: Khorvak, a dwarven engineer
finding-the-schematics-talking-to-khorva.text: Haha, yesh, I have jusht the shing!

finding-the-schematics-talking-to-khorva.speaker: Khorvak, a dwarven engineer
finding-the-schematics-talking-to-khorva.text: I've been working on thish deshign for quite a while now!

finding-the-schematics-talking-to-khorva.speaker: Khorvak, a dwarven engineer
finding-the-schematics-talking-to-khorva.text: Never got to test it, love to shee it shoot a real human!

finding-the-schematics-talking-to-khorva.player: Well, can you give them to me? I'd be willing to try the experiment.

finding-the-schematics-talking-to-khorva.speaker: Khorvak, a dwarven engineer
finding-the-schematics-talking-to-khorva.text: Oooh, shure, shure... I've only got one part left, though, I gave all the other parts away.

finding-the-schematics-talking-to-khorva.player: Who did you give them to?

finding-the-schematics-talking-to-khorva.speaker: Khorvak, a dwarven engineer
finding-the-schematics-talking-to-khorva.text: How should I know? I'm only a shimple dwarf.

finding-the-schematics-talking-to-khorva.player: Okay, okay, can I have that one schematic then?

finding-the-schematics-talking-to-khorva.speaker: Khorvak, a dwarven engineer
finding-the-schematics-talking-to-khorva.text: Just give me a drink and I'll gladly help you.

options.text: No, I've had enough of buying drinks for people!

steps.player: No, I've had enough of buying drinks for people!
It's always like this... Sure, I'll help you [player name], just as soon as you get me a drink!
And more often than not they actually want a very special kind of drink that can only be gotten in the next town, or beyond.
And what is wrong with all you people anyway? Sometimes it seems as if half the population of Gielinor are alcoholics!
So, no, I won't do it anymore, you can get your own drink for once, and I'm just going to stay right here until you've done so!

steps.speaker: Khorvak, a dwarven engineer
steps.text: Pffft, I only wanted a dwarven shtout from that table over there.

steps.speaker: Khorvak, a dwarven engineer
steps.text: Here, have the shtupid schematic, I've gone right off my drink now.

finding-the-schematics-back-to-rolad.speaker: Rolad
finding-the-schematics-back-to-rolad.text: Of course, anything to help a fellow dwarf, especially such a big, strong one such as yourself!

finding-the-schematics-back-to-rolad.player: Dondakan wants to modify his multicannon, you see, to fire a human.

finding-the-schematics-back-to-rolad.speaker: Rolad
finding-the-schematics-back-to-rolad.text: A human, you say? Are we using humans as cannon fodder now?

finding-the-schematics-back-to-rolad.speaker: Rolad
finding-the-schematics-back-to-rolad.text: Well, good for him, never did like humans anyway.

finding-the-schematics-back-to-rolad.player: But can you help me with the schematics? Dondakan needs to know what he needs to modify.

finding-the-schematics-back-to-rolad.speaker: Rolad
finding-the-schematics-back-to-rolad.text: Oh, I see, I see. No, I have no schematics to... what did you say? Modify the cannon to shoot humans? Such a preposterous idea.

finding-the-schematics-back-to-rolad.speaker: Rolad
finding-the-schematics-back-to-rolad.text: No, all I have are the base schematics of the cannon. I was on the multicannon project once, you know?

finding-the-schematics-back-to-rolad.player: Oh, those will be a tremendous help already, can I borrow those off of you as well?

finding-the-schematics-back-to-rolad.speaker: Rolad
finding-the-schematics-back-to-rolad.text: Well, of course, I have the schematics written down on a piece of paper somewhere. Let me just look for it.

finding-the-schematics-back-to-rolad.speaker: Rolad
finding-the-schematics-back-to-rolad.text: Oh dear, I seem to have lost the schematics.

options.text: You are rather a forgetful person, aren't you?

steps.player: You are rather a forgetful person, aren't you?

steps.speaker: Rolad
steps.text: I hardly ever lose anything, I'll have you know!

steps.speaker: Rolad
steps.text: Now, you wouldn't be able to go and look for the schematics, would you?

steps.player: Oh, alright, I'll go and have a look.

options.text: I'd better look for them as well then?

finding-the-schematics-talking-to-rolad-.player: Er, yes, I lost your book...

finding-the-schematics-talking-to-rolad-.speaker: Rolad
finding-the-schematics-talking-to-rolad-.text: Lucky that I have another copy, isn't it? Please don't lose it again.

finding-the-schematics-talking-to-rolad-.player: I can't seem to find your schematics... Did you lose them down in the mines again?

finding-the-schematics-talking-to-rolad-.speaker: Rolad
finding-the-schematics-talking-to-rolad-.text: Oh, let's see... well... maybe. I'm not altogether sure where I left them.

finding-the-schematics-talking-to-rolad-.speaker: Rolad

finding-the-schematics-talking-to-rolad-.speaker: Rolad
finding-the-schematics-talking-to-rolad-.text: Oh, of course, why didn't I think of that!

steps.text: And you'd be the test subject? I mean, the cannonball?

steps.player: Ehm, yes, I suppose so...

steps.speaker: Dwarven Engineer
steps.text: Haha, that I would like to see!

steps.speaker: Dwarven Engineer
steps.text: Here, take this. Khorvak sent it to me from White Wolf Mountain, kind of as a joke. It's incomplete, of course, doesn't mean anything without other parts.

steps.speaker: Dwarven Engineer
steps.text: Haha, he's always a laugh, that Khorvak. Shooting humans out of cannons!

steps.player: Thanks... I suppose.

steps.player: Where... where am I?
What is this place?

steps.text: You hear muffled sounds through the rock wall.

steps.player: Dondakan said there was supposed to be a river behind the rock... but I don't see a river here.

steps.text: You start to feel a little claustrophobic in here...

steps.player: I think... I think... I think I may be...
...inside the rock!

steps.speaker: Arzinian Being of Bordanzan
steps.text: You are in my domain now! Begone lest you wish to be destroyed!

steps.player: What? What was that?

steps.player: Ready as I'll ever be...

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf

steps.player: Err, maybe another time, I have some important business to attend to.

between-a-rock-talking-to-dondakan-after.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
between-a-rock-talking-to-dondakan-after.text: So, tell me! What did you see inside! Is there any gold in there?

between-a-rock-talking-to-dondakan-after.player: I ehm, also ran into this spirit thing. You remember, from the book?

between-a-rock-talking-to-dondakan-after.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
between-a-rock-talking-to-dondakan-after.text: Ran into him? How do you mean?

between-a-rock-talking-to-dondakan-after.player: The rock... seems to be a lot larger than it appears on the outside. I was actually able to walk around in there. But it was like... walking around in a dream.

between-a-rock-talking-to-dondakan-after.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
between-a-rock-talking-to-dondakan-after.text: And this spirit you speak of? Was it guarding the gold?

between-a-rock-talking-to-dondakan-after.player: I'm not quite sure, it all seems so distant now.

between-a-rock-talking-to-dondakan-after.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
between-a-rock-talking-to-dondakan-after.text: Well, if it is, that must mean you must kill it! Simple!

between-a-rock-talking-to-dondakan-after.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
between-a-rock-talking-to-dondakan-after.text: So are you ready to have another go in the rock?

steps.player: Ready as I'll ever be...

steps.speaker: Arzinian Being of Bordanzan
steps.text: Stop what you're doing or taste my wrath!

steps.speaker: Arzinian Being of Bordanzan
steps.text: Do not touch what is not yours!

steps.speaker: Arzinian Being of Bordanzan
steps.text: I would not do that again if I were you!

steps.speaker: Arzinian Being of Bordanzan
steps.text: You are bringing doom down on yourself!

between-a-rock-facing-the-arzinian-being.speaker: Arzinian Being of Bordanzan
between-a-rock-facing-the-arzinian-being.text: You did not heed my messages to stay away! You have brought doom down on to yourself!

between-a-rock-facing-the-arzinian-being.speaker: Arzinian Being of Bordanzan
between-a-rock-facing-the-arzinian-being.text: There are many aspects to my being and there are many skills I possess.

steps.speaker: Arzinian Being of Bordanzan
steps.text: You, I can see, are a skilled warrior. Yet your might is no match for my magic!

between-a-rock-facing-the-arzinian-being.text: If your highest combat stat is Ranged:

steps.speaker: Arzinian Being of Bordanzan
steps.text: You are an able ranger, yet that is useless against my might!

between-a-rock-facing-the-arzinian-being.text: If your highest combat stat is Magic:

steps.speaker: Arzinian Being of Bordanzan
steps.text: Your magical abilities are impressive, but my powers of archery will foil them!

between-a-rock-facing-the-arzinian-being.speaker: Arzinian Being of Bordanzan
between-a-rock-facing-the-arzinian-being.text: Behold, as my avatar descends to your level to extinguish the flame of your puny existence!

steps.speaker: Arzinian Being of Bordanzan
steps.text: I am invincible! You stand no chance against me!

between-a-rock-facing-the-arzinian-being.text: If you have 5-14 gold in your inventory:

steps.speaker: Arzinian Being of Bordanzan
steps.text: You are no match for me!

between-a-rock-facing-the-arzinian-being.text: If you have 15+ gold in your inventory:

steps.speaker: Arzinian Being of Bordanzan
steps.text: And while your power is great, mortal, I will still resist you!

steps.speaker: Arzinian Avatar of [Magic/Ranging/Strength]
steps.text: Your puny efforts cannot harm me!

steps.speaker: Arzinian Avatar of [Magic/Ranging/Strength]
steps.text: Give up and resign yourself to your death!

between-a-rock-finishing-up.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
between-a-rock-finishing-up.text: The whole cave was shaking! What happened in there?

between-a-rock-finishing-up.player: I em... let me just collect my thoughts. It all seems like a sort of distant dream now.
I think I killed the Arzinian demon thing.
Well, I killed its avatar. I'm not sure what happened to the demon itself.

between-a-rock-finishing-up.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
between-a-rock-finishing-up.text: Probably banished it to some hellish realm or other.

between-a-rock-finishing-up.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
between-a-rock-finishing-up.text: He'll be back, but not for a few thousand years, I'm sure.

between-a-rock-finishing-up.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
between-a-rock-finishing-up.text: But in the mean time, there's plenty of gold for me!

between-a-rock-finishing-up.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
between-a-rock-finishing-up.text: Of course, of course! Whenever you want to go back in there, let me know... just don't forget to bring your helmet!

between-a-rock-finishing-up.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
between-a-rock-finishing-up.text: And here, have this rune pickaxe as well, I can just use a normal one now anyway.

between-a-rock-finishing-up.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
between-a-rock-finishing-up.text: No no, thank you! After all these years, the riddle of the rock has finally been cracked!

steps.text: Dondakan tried to hand you a rune pickaxe, but you dropped it on the ground.

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Oh dear, oh dear. It seems firing you head first into a rock was perhaps not the best idea, you've gone absolutely loony.

steps.player: Hmm, well you do have a point...

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: It's alright Laddie, I'm just joking.

options.text: That's great, but I have to go.

steps.player: That's great, but I have to go now.

steps.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
steps.text: Come back any time!

post-quest-hugi-the-librarian.speaker: Librarian
post-quest-hugi-the-librarian.text: Welcome to the Keldagrim library, human traveller!

options.text: Can you tell me more about the library?
What do you know about impenetrable rocks?

steps.player: What do you know about impenetrable rocks?

steps.speaker: Librarian
steps.text: You're confusing me, what rock exactly are you talking about?

steps.player: The big one in the mines south of the city. Dondakan's big rock.

steps.speaker: Librarian
steps.text: I see, I see.

steps.speaker: Librarian
steps.text: I heard there was a demon inside there that you banished.

steps.player: Yes, what exactly does that mean anyway?

steps.speaker: Librarian
steps.text: There are some demons that we cannot see properly as mortals. They also cannot be fought with normal weapons.

steps.speaker: Librarian
steps.text: But sometimes these creatures manifest themselves in a solid form in our world. Their avatar.

steps.speaker: Librarian
steps.text: When you defeat an avatar, you defeat the actual demon behind it. But they don't die, they are banished to where they came from originally.

steps.player: Does that mean I will have to deal with this demon again some time?

steps.speaker: Librarian
steps.text: Doubtful. He will grow stronger and stronger over time, but that's a process that will take a thousand years at least.

steps.speaker: Librarian
steps.text: Even dwarves don't live so long.

steps.speaker: Librarian
steps.text: No, we won't see him again and the mines are safe to dig for gold now. Of course, that might lead to other problems eventually...

-a5r0Z.player: I have that golden helmet you said I'd need, what else did you need again?

-a5r0Z.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
-a5r0Z.text: I still need those schematics to modify my cannon. It doesn't normally fire humans, you know.

-a5r0Z.player: Sounds simple enough. Any idea on where I can find those schematics?

-a5r0Z.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
-a5r0Z.text: Not a clue! I don't even know how many parts there are. It's probably best to ask any dwarven engineers that you might know.

-a5r0Z.speaker: Dondakan the Dwarf
-a5r0Z.text: And it could be that someone in the mines or the city here knows where this part came from. Didn't you talk to someone in Keldagrim already? Just ask around!
